√lakṣ 'mark'
present: [1.] lakṣate lakṣati 
secondary: causative: lakṣayati lakṣayate etc. E.+ -lakṣita B.+ -lakṣya S.+ lakṣyate E.+ 
derivatives: lakṣá V.+ lakṣaka C. lakṣya U.+ lakṣaṇa B.+ lakṣaṇīya C. lákṣman V.+ lakṣmī́ V.+ -lakṣayitavya E. 
Really a denominative formation from lakṣá, but having attained the position and value of a secondary root.
